# Suthahar Jegatheesan

> Cloud, AI & Mobile Solutions Architect in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, with 19+ years in enterprise architecture. Technical Architect at Continental Tire. Microsoft Azure Content Hero, Microsoft Certified Trainer (MCT) and C# Corner MVP. Creator of MSDEVBUILD.

## Facts
- Role: Technical Architect — Senior Application Specialist, Continental Tire, Petaling Jaya, Malaysia (Jan 2022 – present)
- Previously: Cloud & Mobile Technical Architect, Mindtree (2018–2022); Team Lead & Solution Architect, Accenture / Avanade (2011–2018); Senior Software Engineer (2007–2011)
- Focus: Microsoft Azure, Azure AI and Microsoft Foundry, AI agents, GitHub Copilot, Claude, C#, .NET, Python, Flutter, .NET MAUI, Google Cloud, Firebase, DevOps, FinOps
- Reach: 5M+ content views, 15,000+ developers reached, 50+ conference talks
- Certifications: MCT, GH-300 GitHub Copilot, AZ-300, AZ-301, AZ-104, AI-100, DP-900, MCPD, SAFe 4 Scrum Master
- Awards: Microsoft Azure Content Hero, C# Corner MVP, Top 100 Microsoft Azure Blogs, Accenture Customer Impact Award, Avanade Orange Award, Titan Award
